home.heading: Your business pages start here
home.body: This skeleton ships no business domain. A product puts its pages under src/pages and names them in one place, the route table in src/routes.tsx, which feeds both the navigation and the rendered view.

account.title: Account settings
account.description: Manage your account: your profile, password, sign-in identifiers, preferences, active sessions, linked sign-in methods and two-step verification.
